name: reconnect
description: Sends your Claude Code session events to Reconnect, so you can get back into any lane in about 30 seconds. Never blocks Claude Code.

url.title: Reconnect address
url.description: The address of your Reconnect server, for example http://localhost:4317 or your Tailscale name. Leave empty if your organization set it for you.

token.title: Reconnect token
token.description: The RECONNECT_TOKEN of your Reconnect server. Leave empty if your organization set it for you.
